listing.name: Omega's External Settings
listing.summary: With what is unironically a DIY toolkit, you can go into the settings.json file of this mod and change vanilla settings like fleet size, the maximum size of battles, and even how many S-Mods you can put on your ships, all without touching the vanilla settings.json file!
listing.aiSummary: Lets you change vanilla game settings like fleet size and battle limits via a custom settings file.

description:
So, are you like me, and definitely didn't go into the vanilla files to change certain values because you wanted to make things more fun (or absolutely insane, because why not)?

...yeah, about that.

Now you (...and I, lmao) don't have to do that, with Omega's External Settings!

With what is unironically a DIY toolkit, you can go into the settings.json file of this mod and change vanilla settings like fleet size, the maximum size of battles, and even how many S-Mods you can put on your ships, all without touching the vanilla settings.json file!

Omega's External Settings 1.0

(Disclaimer, this mod does not actually make changes on its own, it just acts as a way for users, myself included, to make some of the changes they want without going into the vanilla settings.json file to do so.)

(Secondary Disclaimer, as with Colonial Ascension, which by the way is still usable even if the mod's page says "merged", this mod can be independently updated with a simple version number change...unless Starsector itself adds an update that completely changes the settings.json in a way that makes this mod nonfunctional, but...I doubt that. Feel free to throw me a ping in the Unofficial Starsector Discord if it does, even if I'm not really sure what I'd be able to do about that.)

aiDescription: Provides a DIY toolkit for modifying vanilla game settings without editing the core game files. Users can adjust values such as fleet size, maximum battle size, and S-Mod limits by editing a settings.json file included with the mod. It acts as an external configuration layer rather than automatically applying changes.
